sections.tldr: TL;DR: EdifyEdu cannot confirm an online BCA at REVA University. REVA appears in the UGC Distance Education Bureau recognition list of August 2026, but that document names programmes without stating whether a grant covers Online mode or Open and Distance Learning. The UGC DEB programme register does not list REVA University, and REVA advertises on-campus programmes only on its own website. REVA has told EdifyEdu that it does not run an MBA in online mode. Treat this page as a status note, not an admission page.
sections.ugcDeb: REVA University appears in the UGC Distance Education Bureau recognition list published in August 2026, which names 9 programmes for the university including Bachelor of Computer Applications. That document carries no mode column, so it does not establish whether the grant covers Online mode or Open and Distance Learning. The DEB programme register at deb.ugc.ac.in, which does state the mode against each programme, does not list REVA University. EdifyEdu has not been able to confirm an Online mode entitlement for this programme. Check deb.ugc.ac.in and ask REVA University directly before you act on anything here.
redFlags: REVA University has told EdifyEdu that it does not offer an MBA in online mode. Do not read this page as evidence that an online programme exists.
The August 2026 UGC document names programmes but not the delivery mode. Appearing in it does not by itself establish an Online mode entitlement.
The UGC DEB programme register, which does state the mode, does not list REVA University. Confirm the current position at deb.ugc.ac.in.
No fee is published for this programme. Any figure quoted to you by a third party should be confirmed in writing with the university before you pay.

faqs.question: Does REVA University offer an online BCA?
faqs.answer: EdifyEdu cannot confirm that it does. REVA has told us it runs no MBA in online mode, its own website advertises on-campus programmes only, and the UGC DEB programme register does not list the university. Contact REVA University directly and check deb.ugc.ac.in for the current position.

faqs.question: Why does REVA appear in the August 2026 UGC list then?
faqs.answer: That list names the programmes granted to each institution but carries no mode column, so it does not separate Online mode from Open and Distance Learning. EdifyEdu earlier read it as an online grant. The document does not support that reading.

faqs.question: What should I do if I want to study at REVA University?
faqs.answer: Approach REVA University directly through reva.edu.in for its current programme options and admission process. Confirm the delivery mode and the UGC position in writing before you pay anything.

faqs.question: How long is the BCA?
faqs.answer: 3 Years as named in the August 2026 list.
